Attack Shark X98Pro Tri-Mode Wireless Mechanical Gaming Keyboard (99 Keys / Blueberry Linear Switches / LED Screen / Gasket Mount / Star Black)

Experience the pinnacle of mechanical keyboard craftsmanship with the Attack Shark X98Pro Tri-Mode Wireless Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, arriving in a premium Star Black colorway at Turbo Computer Egypt. This advanced 98% layout keyboard packs 99 essential keys and a dedicated number pad into a highly optimized, space-saving footprint. Built for enthusiasts, it features a flexible Gasket-mounted layout integrated with an FR4 1.2mm single-key flex-cut PCB matrix and an acoustic 5-layer muffler filling system (including PORON sandwich cotton and IXPE switch pads) to deliver a deep, pure "thocky" typing acoustics ecosystem. The X98 Pro features a vibrant 1.5-inch LED color display that reads real-time system diagnostics alongside a multifunction CNC rotary knob for flawless media management setup. Equipped with pre-lubed, hot-swappable Blueberry custom linear switches, south-facing 16M color RGB lighting, double-shot PBT keycaps, and a massive 4000mAh rechargeable battery matrix, this tri-mode beast (2.4GHz / Bluetooth / Wired) redefines premium desktop typing performance.
